author: PostOakLabs
description: Vendor-neutral linter for a declared token-record schema: checks declared display mask expressions, alias template and search-index expressions, sensitive-authentication-data retention, and digest fields against the published PAN display-masking rule and account-data storage rules. The input is a schema declaration, never card data. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

alias_template.description: Display template aliases of the PAN are declared to use, e.g. prefix:6,suffix:4

container_path.description: Where the declared record is described as living; echoed, never scanned

elem_1_encrypted.description: Element slot 1 stored encrypted, true or false

elem_1_retention.description: Element slot 1 retention: before_authorization, during_authorization_only, after_authorization

elem_1_sad.description: Element slot 1 sensitive class: none, full_track_data, card_verification_code, pin_or_pin_block

elem_1_storage.description: Element slot 1 storage location class: persistent, non_persistent_memory, ephemeral_process

field_1_class.description: Field slot 1 value class: primary_account_number, card_verification_code, pin_or_pin_block, full_track_data, deterministic_digest, other

field_1_digest_target.description: Field slot 1 digest target for deterministic_digest fields, e.g. entire_pan

field_1_keyed.description: Field slot 1 digest keyed, true or false

field_1_mask.description: Field slot 1 mask expression for PAN fields: prefix:N, suffix:N, redact:N, redact:all, plain

record_type.description: Label for the record kind the schema describes

search_index_expressions.description: One declared search-index display expression per line

mcp_tool_definition.description: Lints a declared token-record schema against the published PCI DSS v4.0.1 account-data rules: display exposure against the first-six-and-last-four masking ceiling, sensitive authentication data retention after authorization, and digest fields. Unrecognized input values refuse the whole call. Checks a schema declaration, not a production data store; not a PCI DSS assessment. Client-side only, zero PII.

record.description: Declared record schema: record_type, fields, optional alias_template, optional search_index_expressions

stored_elements.description: Declared stored data elements: name, sad_class, retention, storage_location_class, encrypted

mcp_tool_definition.name: lint_pan_sad_exposure

alias_analysis.description: Ceiling check over the declared alias template

ceilings.description: The first-six and last-four digit ceilings applied

field_exposure.description: Per-declared-field display exposure against the ceiling

findings.description: Findings with the cited requirement paragraph per finding

issues.description: Mirror of the compliance flags as human-readable issue lines

manual_review.description: Named manual-review flags for carve-out conditions the caller owns

manual_review_required.description: True when at least one manual-review flag or an unanalyzed display expression is present

refusal_reasons.description: Structured refusal reasons; present only when the call is refused

search_index_analysis.description: Ceiling checks over each declared search-index expression

title: PAN and SAD Exposure Linter
